DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 拾得物の届けについてのお問い合わせですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're asking about a found-property report, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。先ほど届けた小物の控えです。拾った場所を反対側と伝えてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 以前の届けの控えを提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Here is the receipt for the small item I handed in earlier. I mistakenly said I found it on the opposite side.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show the receipt for your earlier report. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 元の記載では、東側の歩道となっていますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: The original entry says the sidewalk on the east side.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 正しくは西側です。道路を渡る前に拾ったので、帰り道で考えて気付きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 発見場所の訂正を申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: It was actually the west side. I picked it up before crossing the road, and realized my mistake while thinking about it on my way home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask to correct the place where you found it. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 物を拾った時刻や、品物は変わりませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Are the time you found it and the item unchanged?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 時刻は午後二時で変わりません。すでに預けた品物も同じです。場所だけ訂正したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 誤った場所と正しい場所を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: The time is still two in the afternoon. The item I already handed over is the same too. I only want to correct the location.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish the incorrect location from the correct one. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 控えの番号で元の届けを確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll use the receipt number to check the original report.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 新しい届けを別に作るのではなく、元の記録の発見場所を直してもらうんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 発見時刻は同じだと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: So rather than making another new report, you'll correct the discovery location in the original record.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that the discovery time is unchanged. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。地図で正しい位置を示してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Please show the correct spot on the map.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ここです。道路の西側、交差点から二つ目の街灯の下です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 元の届けに訂正を加えてもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Here. On the west side of the road, under the second streetlight from the intersection.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Have a correction added to the original report. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認できました。元の届けの発見場所に訂正を加え、時刻と品物はそのまま記録します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've confirmed it. I'll correct the discovery location in the original report and keep the recorded time and item unchanged.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 転居後の郵便についてですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is about your mail after moving, right?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。新居の建物名が変わりました。転居届には、契約時の古い名前を書きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 新居の建物名が変わったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. My new building's name has changed. On my mail-forwarding notification I wrote the old name from when I signed the contract.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that the new building's name has changed. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 番地や部屋番号も変わっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have the street number and room number changed too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いいえ。番地と三〇一号室は同じで、建物名だけ違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 番地と部屋番号は同じだと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: No. The street number and room 301 are unchanged; only the building name differs.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the street number and room number are unchanged. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 届の内容を担当に確認して、必要な対応をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check the notification with the staff and explain what action is needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 古い名前と新しい名前を、このメモに並べました。別の建物へまた引っ越したわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 届に使った旧名を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I listed the old and new names side by side on this note. I haven't moved again to another building.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the old name used in the notification. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その点も担当へお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please explain that point to the staff too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。新しい住所の届を重ねて出す前に、今の届を見てもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 登録の確認を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please help me with that. Before submitting another new-address notification on top of the existing one, I'd like you to look at the current notification.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for the registration to be checked. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 受付の控えを拝見します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: May I see your submission receipt?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: こちらです。同じ番地と部屋で建物名だけ変更、と確認してから訂正します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 担当の案内で訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Here it is. I'll first confirm that the street number and room are the same and only the building name has changed, then make the correction.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Correct it according to the staff's instructions. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。その内容で担当へ照会し、必要な手順をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll ask the staff about those details and explain the required procedure.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 登録情報の変更ですね。何が変わりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You'd like to update your registered information. What has changed?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 勤務先です。先月末に退職したので、登録の会社ではもう働いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 退職による情報変更を申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: My workplace. I left my job at the end of last month, so I no longer work at the registered company.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request an information update because you left your job. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 新しい勤務先はお決まりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you decided on a new workplace?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。面接を受けている会社はありますが、採用が決まったわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 旧勤務先で働いていないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. There is a company where I'm interviewing, but I haven't been hired.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you no longer work at the old company. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今の状態でどのように変更するか、担当者が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The staff member will check how to update it for your current situation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。予定の会社名を書くか、古い会社を残すか、勝手に選びたくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 次の勤務先が未定だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I don't want to choose on my own between writing the prospective company's name and leaving the old company's name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that your next workplace is undecided. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 退職日と、現在の就業状況が分かるようにお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please clearly explain the date you left and your current employment situation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 退職は九月三十日、現在は仕事を探しています。次の会社は未定です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 現在の状態の登録方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I left on September 30 and am currently looking for work. My next company is undecided.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask how to register your current situation. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その内容で登録の担当へご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll refer you to the registration staff with those details.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 決まっていない会社名は書かず、現在の状態に合う記入方法を聞いてから変更します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未確定の会社名を記入せず確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't write an unconfirmed company name; I'll ask how to fill it out for my current situation before updating it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check without writing an unconfirmed company name. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。退職済みで次の勤務先は未定という内容で、担当へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll tell the staff that you have left your job and your next workplace is undecided.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 同じ商品でお迷いですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble choosing between the same product?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。こちらの二袋は同じ名前なのに、片方だけ安いですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同じ商品の価格差を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. These two bags have the same name, but only one is cheaper.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the price difference between the same product. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 安い方は期限が近い商品です。日付をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: The cheaper one is close to its expiry date. Please look at the dates.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 安い方は明日、もう一方は来週ですね。私は週末に食べる予定です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 期限が異なると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: The cheaper one is dated tomorrow, and the other next week. I plan to eat it on the weekend.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that the expiry dates differ. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 予定に合わせてお選びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please choose according to your plans.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 明日までの物は今回やめて、週末より後の期限の袋にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 食べる予定日を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll skip the one dated tomorrow this time and take a bag with a date after the weekend.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say when you plan to eat it. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの袋の日付も、一つずつお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check each bag's date individually as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この袋は来週の火曜日ですね。保存方法も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 近い期限の商品を避けると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: This bag is dated next Tuesday. I'll check the storage instructions too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide to avoid the product with the near expiry date. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。袋の裏に記載があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. They are printed on the back of the bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 期限と保存方法を読みました。今日は通常価格のこちらを一袋買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 選んだ袋の期限を読む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've read the date and storage instructions. Today I'll buy one of these at the regular price.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Read the date on the bag you selected. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。選ばれた袋をレジへお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please take your chosen bag to the checkout.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 地図で行き方を確認されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you checking the route on the map?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。この点線を通れば、池の向こうへ早く行けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 地図の線の意味を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. If I follow this dotted line, can I quickly get to the other side of the pond?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask what the line on the map means. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その点線は区画の境界です。歩く道ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: That dotted line marks a section boundary. It is not a walking path.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 線があるから道だと思いました。池を渡れる橋の表示とは違うんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 近道と思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought it was a path because there was a line. So it isn't a symbol for a bridge across the pond.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you thought it was a shortcut. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。園路は太い実線で示しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: That's right. Park paths are shown with thick solid lines.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 太い実線をたどると、池の北側を回って広場へ行くんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 歩ける道の表示を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Following the thick solid line, I go around the north side of the pond to the plaza, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm how walkable paths are marked. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その経路が歩ける道です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: That route is the walking path.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 地図の直線を近道にせず、北側の園路で回ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 池を回る経路を指でたどる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't treat the straight line on the map as a shortcut; I'll go around on the park path on the north side.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Trace the route around the pond with your finger. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 現地には広場へ向かう案内板もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: There are also signs to the plaza on site.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 太い実線と案内板を照らし合わせて歩きます。点線の所へ入ろうとしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 園路の表示に沿って歩くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll walk by checking the thick solid line against the signs. I won't try to enter the area with the dotted line.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will walk along the marked park paths. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ。最初の分岐は左です。園路に沿ってお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11218-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please do. Turn left at the first fork and follow the park path.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どちらの案内をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: What information are you looking for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 目的駅の東口に近い車両です。足が疲れやすいので、ホームを長く歩かずに降りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 目的駅と出口を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Which car is close to the east exit at my destination station. My legs tire easily, so I'd like to get off without walking a long way along the platform.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: State your destination station and exit. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この掲示は、この駅の出口の位置を示しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: This notice shows the exits at this station.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この駅ではなく、降りる駅の東口に近い位置を知りたかったんです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 歩く距離を短くしたいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I wanted to know the position close to the east exit at the station where I'm getting off, rather than this station.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to reduce the walking distance. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 目的駅の案内を別に確認しましょう。列車の両数も分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check your destination station's information separately. Do you know how many cars the train has?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 乗るのは八両です。十両の案内を見ても、そのまま同じ号車とは限らないですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 車両位置の案内対象を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: The one I'm taking has eight cars. Even if I look at information for ten cars, it isn't necessarily the same car number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm which station the car-position guidance covers. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。八両の停車位置に合う案内で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Correct. We'll check guidance matching an eight-car train's stopping position.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。八両の列車と目的駅の東口、この二つで確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 編成による違いを聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. I'd like to check these two things: an eight-car train and my destination station's east exit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about differences depending on train formation. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 案内では前寄りですが、当日の停車表示もご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: The guidance says toward the front, but please check the stopping-position signs on the day too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 前寄りへ移り、八両の停車表示を見て乗ります。降りたら東口の案内を確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 現地表示で確かめて乗ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll move toward the front and board after checking the eight-car stopping-position sign. When I get off, I'll confirm the east-exit signs.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will check the signs on site before boarding. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その手順でどうぞ。前寄りへ向かう通路はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please follow those steps. This is the passage toward the front.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 何人で転入されましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 実際に来たのは私一人です。妻と子供は来月来る予定で、今は旧住所にいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 本人が先に転居したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Only I have actually arrived. My wife and child plan to come next month and are still at our old address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you moved ahead of your family. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご家族は、まだ転居していないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: So your family hasn't moved yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。三人で住む予定なので、今日三人とも書いてよいと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 家族は旧住所だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: That's right. Since we plan to live here as a family of three, I thought I could list all three of us today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that your family is at the old address. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 予定と実際の転居を分けて、担当にお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please explain your plans and the actual move separately to the staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今回は私の転居について相談し、家族の分は後で実際に来てから確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 家族の予定日と実際の転居を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: This time I'd like to ask about my own move, and confirm my family's procedures after they actually arrive later.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Separate your family's planned date from the actual move. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。ご家族が後日転居する場合の案内もお渡しできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. We can also give you information for when your family moves at a later date.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。今日の届に予定日を転居済みとして書かないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 今回の届の対象を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. I'll make sure not to write the planned date on today's notification as if they've already moved.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm who is covered by this notification. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 本人の転居日と、家族の予定日をメモしておいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please note down your own move date and your family's planned date.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 私の実際の日付はこちら、家族は来月の予定です。今回の対象を担当と確認して記入します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 後日の家族分は別に相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Here is my actual date; my family plans to come next month. I'll check with the staff who is covered this time before filling it out.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will consult separately about your family's later move. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。その状況を住所異動の担当へお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll explain those circumstances to the address-change staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 予約についてのご確認ですね。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。案内カードが二枚あり、日付が違います。電話で変更した後、古い方も残していました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二枚の案内を提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I have two information cards with different dates. After changing it by phone, I kept the old one too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show the two information cards. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お名前と、変更のご連絡をされた日をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please give me your name and the date you called to make the change.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昨日の午後です。元は木曜、新しい候補は月曜と言われました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 電話で変更した経緯を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yesterday afternoon. It was originally Thursday, and I was told the new proposed day was Monday.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain how you changed it by phone. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 登録では、月曜日の午前十一時に変更されています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: The record shows it has been changed to Monday at eleven in the morning.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今の予約は月曜十一時なんですね。木曜のカードは、どう扱えばいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 現在の有効日時を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: So the current appointment is Monday at eleven. What should I do with the Thursday card?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the currently valid date and time. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 古い案内だと分かるように印を付けるか、保管を分けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Mark it so you can tell it is the old information, or store it separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 古いカードには「変更前」と書き、当日持つ袋から出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 古いカードの扱いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll write 'before the change' on the old card and remove it from the bag I'll bring that day.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask how to handle the old card. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。変更後の案内をお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. I'll give you the updated information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 月曜十一時を確認しました。予定表も直し、木曜の予定は予約として残さないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 予定表も新日時へそろえる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've confirmed Monday at eleven. I'll also correct my calendar and make sure Thursday doesn't remain listed as an appointment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Update your calendar to match the new date and time. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。現在の予約は月曜十一時です。こちらの新しい案内をお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Your current appointment is Monday at eleven. Please take this new information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 自転車がなくなったとのことですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Your bicycle has gone missing, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。ただ、全部なくなったのではなく、鍵でつないだ前輪だけが残っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自転車の一部だけ残ったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. But not all of it is gone; only the front wheel, which I secured with a lock, is left.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that only part of the bicycle remains. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 車体と後輪はなく、前輪だけその場にあるのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: So the frame and rear wheel are gone, and only the front wheel is still there.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうです。前輪だけを見て、自転車がまだあると言われると違うので、状態を説明したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 残った前輪とない部分を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: That's right. It wouldn't be correct for someone to look only at the front wheel and say the bicycle is still there, so I'd like to explain its condition.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish the remaining front wheel from the missing parts. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 最後に全体がそろっていた場所と時刻をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell me the place and time you last saw the complete bicycle.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 昨日の夕方、駅の東駐輪場の三列目です。今朝は前輪と鍵だけでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 駐輪場所と最後の確認時刻を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yesterday evening, in the third row of the east bicycle parking area at the station. This morning there were only the front wheel and lock.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the parking location and the last time you checked. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 現場の写真はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you have photos of the scene?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: こちらです。残った前輪も、周りの駐輪位置も写っています。まだ部品を持ち帰っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 現場の写真を提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Here they are. They show the remaining front wheel and the surrounding parking positions. I haven't taken the parts home yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show photos of the scene. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当者が写真と状況を確認します。残った部分の扱いもご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: The staff will check the photos and situation. Please also ask them how to handle the remaining parts.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。前輪を動かす前に、なくなった車体と後輪のことを伝え、担当の案内を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 残った部品を動かす前に担当に相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please help me. Before moving the front wheel, I'll explain that the frame and rear wheel are missing and listen to the staff's instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Consult the staff before moving the remaining parts. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。前輪のみ残っている状況として、場所、時刻、写真を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll check the location, time, and photos, noting that only the front wheel remains.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 封筒は、もう封をしてありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you already sealed the envelope?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: まだです。中は書類のコピーで、原本は手元に残しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 封筒の中身がコピーだと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Not yet. Inside are copies of the documents; I've kept the originals with me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the envelope contains copies. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 必要な書類の形式は、提出先の案内でご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please check the recipient's instructions for the required form of the documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうですね。送れる方法だけでなく、コピーで受け付けてもらえるか先に確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 送付条件の確認が未了だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: You're right. Before deciding just how to send it, I'll first confirm whether they accept copies.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you haven't finished checking the submission requirements. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 内容が整ってから、発送のお手続きに進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can proceed with shipping once the contents are ready.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 案内を読むと、原本の提出とありました。ここでコピーのまま送るのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 提出先の案内を読む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Reading the instructions, it says the originals must be submitted. I'll stop here rather than send the copies as they are.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Read the recipient's instructions. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、内容を整えてからお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then please bring it back after preparing the contents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 原本を持っているので、記入台で入れ替えます。コピーは自分の控えにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 原本指定に合わせて入れ替える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have the originals, so I'll swap them at the writing desk. I'll keep the copies for my records.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Replace the contents to meet the requirement for originals. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 封をする前に、必要な枚数もご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also check the required number of pages before sealing it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 原本二枚がそろいました。コピーと分けて封をしました。この完成した封筒を送ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 完成後に発送を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have both originals, two pages. I've separated them from the copies and sealed the envelope. I'll send this completed envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Request shipping after finishing the preparation. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。こちらの封筒で発送方法をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll explain the shipping options for this envelope.
